whatsNew: The Android app now uses a 75% WebView scale so more of the website fits comfortably on phone screens.
The mobile website viewport is restored to the real device width instead of forcing a wide desktop canvas inside the Android app.
Global layout width constraints prevent pages and admin content from expanding past the phone screen and being pushed off to the right.
The native Android update checker, APK installer, and bottom-center Home control remain available.
